c180616033.notes: Trilingual interpretive panel on a wall in Ksar Beni Isguen (Ghardaia). Only the three title banners (English, French, Arabic, left to right) are transcribed; the long paragraph text under each title and the 'OTD' logo are not part of the label.

c28468878.notes: Orange pastry-shop fascia in Batna. Each Arabic line has a Tifinagh (neo-Tifinagh, Berber Academy style glyphs) line under it: 9 glyphs under the name, two words under 'halawiyat wa murattabat'. The Tifinagh lines are NOT transcribed: the glyph-to-Unicode mapping of this letter style is ambiguous and the labeller would have had to guess codepoints; a checker who reads Tifinagh should add them. Garage sign at right and car plates are distractors.
